data.name: MWG_001
data.value: The summit...[pause=15] We're almost there.

data.name: MWG_002
data.value: Look at the sky...[pause=15] Those clouds aren't normal.

data.name: MWG_003
data.value: Is that...[pause=10] a storm?!

data.name: MWG_004
data.value: An...[pause=10] AN AERODACTYL!

data.name: MWG_005
data.value: The Ancient Sky Predator...

data.name: MWG_006
data.value: You...[pause=10] You knew it was here!

data.name: MWG_007
data.value: The mountain's ultimate guardian.[pause=20] It ruled these skies long before anyone set foot on this land.

data.name: MWG_008
data.value: If you triumph here, the path to the ancestral ruins will open to you.

data.name: MWG_009
data.value: Fail...[pause=30] and your journey ends here.

data.name: MWG_010
data.value: Then let's show it our journey is just beginning![pause=10] [player], let's do this!

data.name: MWG_011
data.value: This time, we take it down.[pause=15] I promise, [player].

data.name: MWG_012
data.value: We...[pause=10] We beat it!

data.name: MWG_013
data.value: Look![pause=10] The storm is clearing...

data.name: MWG_014
data.value: That voice...[pause=15] It said something about ancestral ruins.

data.name: MWG_015
data.value: That's where we're going.[pause=20] To the Cloven Ruins.

data.name: MWG_016
data.value: Then let's go![pause=15] The end of the expedition awaits us!

data.name: MWG_017
data.value: The ancient predator shows no mercy...

data.name: MWG_018
data.value: But today's prey is tomorrow's hunter.

data.name: MWG_019
data.value: Rest now.[pause=30] The summit will wait for you.

data.name: MWG_020
data.value: Je...[pause=5] je ne tiens plus debout...[pause=15] L'Aerodactyl est trop puissant !

data.name: MWG_021
data.value: L'Aerodactyl pousse un cri perçant qui déchire le ciel.[pause=15] Il te domine de toute sa stature.

data.name: MWG_022
data.value: Tu n'es pas le premier à tomber,[pause=20] petit grimpeur.[pause=25] Et tu ne seras pas le dernier.

data.name: MWG_023
data.value: Il remonte dans l'orage en deux battements d'ailes.[pause=20] La montagne tremble encore.

data.name: MWG_024
data.value: Le prédateur ancestral s'effondre dans un nuage de poussière.[pause=15] L'orage se dissipe.

data.name: MWG_025
data.value: L'Aerodactyl te regarde, haletant.[pause=20] Puis il baisse la tête.

data.name: MWG_026
data.value: Tu as vaincu le roi de ces cieux.[pause=25] Je... je ne pensais pas voir ça un jour.[pause=30] Va. Le sommet est à toi.

data.name: MWG_027
data.value: Il déploie ses ailes une dernière fois et disparaît dans les nuages.[pause=15] Le silence revient.

data.name: MWG_028
data.value: On l'a...[pause=10] ON L'A VAINCU ![pause=15] Le sommet est à nous !

data.name: MWG_029
data.value: Le plus vieux prédateur plie devant toi.[pause=25] Tu changes les règles de ce monde.
